title: iTRS-derived route handoff into SIP signaling
objective: Prove that an authoritative iTRS-style logical SIP route can be consumed by Baudot without collapsing route identity into immediate transport discovery, while negative authority outcomes fail closed before SIP signaling.

historicalBasis.observation: ACE Direct demonstrates fielded iTRS-style ENUM/NAPTR routing behavior that can yield a logical SIP URI before downstream SIP service discovery.
historicalBasis.scope: Behavioral prior art only. Baudot uses synthetic numbers and domains and does not copy ACE Direct source or infer contemporary provider behavior.

arms.condition: authoritative mock returns a logical E2U+sip route and Baudot sends an INVITE with that URI preserved as the Request-URI
authoritative mock reports no route and no SIP connection attempt is permitted
authoritative mock returns malformed routing data and no SIP connection attempt is permitted
authoritative mock is unavailable and no guessed SIP route is emitted

assertions: a successful authoritative route is required before SIP signaling
negative authority outcomes do not silently become guessed SIP routes
the iTRS-derived logical SIP URI remains the SIP Request-URI
the immediate transport route may differ from the logical SIP URI
receipt of 200 OK does not retroactively redefine the authoritative route
runnableEvidence: typed resolution outcomes for route, not-found, invalid-authority, and authority-unavailable
fail-closed connection gate for negative authority outcomes
live loopback JAIN-SIP INVITE, 200 OK, and ACK transaction
preserved logical SIP Request-URI with separate loose transport Route
requiredBeforeProven: green repeatable CI execution of all fixture, route-gate, and SIP-handoff arms
a second independent SIP implementation consuming the same logical route contract
controlled DNS NAPTR/SRV transport-discovery evidence rather than loopback-only Route injection
authorized non-public iTRS integration evidence without exposing credentials or subscriber data
provider-representative interoperability evidence under explicit authorization
terminal evidence bundle suitable for explicit proven-state review

doesNotEstablish: that any current provider behaves like historical ACE Direct
